item.title: Photography
item.description: I take my camera anywhere and I use it respectfully. Val Aupa in snow-rich winter 2020/21. Val Rosandra in early springtime. Around Laghi di Fusine, towards Canlone della Strugova. Val Saisera on one of these days. Val Alba in one of the longest day of the year. I caught a lightning on a photo.

item.title: PowderGuide.com weather forecasts
item.description: Short History In summer of 2023 croox.com and me started developing a weather service, dedicated to winter mountain activities, in particular skitouring and freeride, and it is operational ever since the release of its first version in December 2023 on powderguide.com. We process and visualize the ICON numerical weather forecasts run by the german weather service DWD. In its third version we are presenting these forecasts on a three-dimensional map and in this article the present PG-ICON-weather v3.
